svg.title: The order behind what I hear
svg.desc: Top-to-bottom sequence with service-owned decisions and explicit persistence boundaries.
svg.text: Sequence: from my words to a saved reservation
Solid arrows are requests/actions; dashed arrows are replies or the conditional post-agent callback. Boxes at right locate the code.
IMPLEMENTED PATH: main 2678845. Successful call = Twin reservation + mocked handoff, not a TMS booking.
Local code / V4 draft shown; repo notes record V3 and an older App as live. Illustrative success path; mocked checkpoints do not establish voice reliability.
B1 Foundations | B2 Verify + storage | B3 Sell + reserve + close | B4 Operate + submit | B5 QA + delivery. Build order is not call order.
save selected MC / lookup + checking event
save hash, expiry, send budget + event
save sent event (not a read receipt)
sent; expected code is not returned
TMS TCP: LOAD_GET for selected loads
filter + price -> save search / offers / pitch event
found + public loads; no ceiling / posted rate
price + atomic answer_counter; ask / round / offer + event
1. fresh price / ACCEPT -> calls.accepting {id, load, MC, rate}
Mocked handoff: "A senior rep will confirm."
first closed_at + summary + event; hold unchanged
ended_at / ended_by / duration + event, if delivered
SEPARATE REP PATH: App -> service -> Twin review. It may run while I am on the call. Only a rep Confirm may send LOAD_BOOK. No voice booking tool; no real transfer; RESERVED is not BOOKED.
Source: main 2678845. File paths are relative to service/ unless marked. C1-C7 are call moments; B1-B5 are build slices. Money is illustrative, not a live trace.
Shared I/O: api.py routes JSON; adapters/twin.py version-checks SQL writes. TMS [B1]: client.py query/get -> protocol.py encode_request/parse_reply -> mapping.py to_summary/to_load.
